summary: This informational report covers the IAB workshop held online on November 9-13, 2020 about network impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic, when quarantine and working from home changed Internet user behavior and traffic. Researchers, operators and network management experts shared experiences. It reports the proceedings and does not necessarily reflect IAB views.

eli5.summary: When everyone stayed home during the pandemic, internet use changed a lot. Experts met online to share what happened to networks, and this document is the notes from that meeting.
